'''Uda-Khalid's headquarters''' were in a temple on a jungle part of an unknown [[planet]] or [[moon]]. It was protected by numerous guards, including a [[Gotal]] [[Unidentified Gotal (Uda-Khalid)|guard]], and was run by [[Uda-Khalid]], a murderous dictator. However, [[Jedi Master|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] came to the temple one time, and ended up killing Uda-Khalid.<ref name="Survivors" />
